claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P for the fixed standard secp256k1 generator P, the phase-coupled six-class Pollard rho in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39, over the uniform challenge and fresh algorithm coins, using at most 2^128.501153 total target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing, distinguished-point handling, exceptional-addition reserve and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^118.735617 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^20 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. Heuristics H_map, H_long, H_dist and H_useful are stated in proof.md. Canonicalization alone is not claimed to remove negation 2-cycles; the mod-3 phase with disjoint per-phase exponents does.

experiments.purpose: On Z/13Z, exhibit the unphased canonical negation 2-cycle and check that the mod-3 phased map has none. Also recover a planted discrete log from two frames. Not a production cost measurement.
